name: @cindy/maker-hermes-manager
description: Cindy local Hermes harness manager: NDJSON RPC daemon wrapping an isolated Hermes Agent install (HERMES_HOME) as a Cindy harness. Spawns per-turn `hermes chat --format stream-json` runs, maps Hermes JSONL events to Cindy query events. Fork-only package; zero Electron deps.
